body:
Filing gate: class (b), a declared contract that the implementation contradicts. Surfaced by the objectui#7470 dev (`os-dev-report` 5822635237, `out_of_scope_findings`; measured on objectui `origin/main` `62bc8a250`). ## What (relayed from the dev; ⛔ not re-run by this seat)

`packages/plugin-map/README.md` describes the `map` key as 「the bare spec view-type name ... for a node authored with it directly」. On a built `@object-ui/types` dist, `safeValidateSchema` of a `map` node carrying `staticData` returns `invalid_union` 「Invalid input」, while an `object-map` node with the same content passes. `AnyComponentSchema` declares no `map` arm.

objectui#8008 retired the same shape for `gantt` (a registered bare key with no schema arm). Whether `map` should be retired the same way, or given an arm, is a ruling this seat does not make.

`Seam: spec:AnyComponentSchema (no 'map' literal) → renderer:ObjectMapRenderer registered as map / view:map`
